title: Fee Schedule and Payment Plans, Manufactured Home Insurance
content:
Hearthstone Insurance Agency bills Manufactured Home Insurance premium under a choice of payment plans, with a policy fee each term and an installment fee on the installment plans. The figures below are the same on every policy form.

## Fees and first payment by form

| Policy form | Policy fee per term (fully earned) | Fee on each semi-annual installment | Fee on each monthly EFT installment | First payment at binding, monthly EFT plan |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Manufactured Home Basic Form - Actual Cash Value | $35.00 | $5.00 | $2.00 | 16.67% of the annual premium |
| Manufactured Home Basic Form - Replacement Cost | $35.00 | $5.00 | $2.00 | 16.67% of the annual premium |
| Manufactured Home Broad Form - Actual Cash Value | $35.00 | $5.00 | $2.00 | 16.67% of the annual premium |
| Manufactured Home Broad Form - Replacement Cost | $35.00 | $5.00 | $2.00 | 16.67% of the annual premium |
| Manufactured Home Special Form - Replacement Cost | $35.00 | $5.00 | $2.00 | 16.67% of the annual premium |
| Manufactured Home Special Form Plus - Extended Replacement Cost | $35.00 | $5.00 | $2.00 | 16.67% of the annual premium |

## Payment plans offered (every form)

- Annual
- Semi-annual
- Monthly EFT (electronic funds transfer)
- Loan escrow — the premium may be billed annually to a Hearthstone Home Finance escrow on every form.

## Channels through which the insured pays premium (every form)

| Channel | Description |
|---|---|
| Online portal, ACH | Bank transfer through the online portal |
| Online portal, card | Card payment through the online portal |
| Monthly EFT draft | The scheduled monthly electronic draft |
| Office cashier's check | Cashier's check presented at the office |
| Mailed check | Check sent by mail |

## Rounding

Installments, fees and refunds are rounded half up to the cent on every form.

## Illustration (hypothetical premium)

On a hypothetical annual premium of $600, the first payment at binding on the monthly EFT plan is 16.67% of $600, that is $100.02. On a hypothetical annual premium of $555, 16.67% is $92.5185, which rounds half up to $92.52.
